#! -rules CONF-04 -strict
# The minters compose 41/5/17 IDs; sizes, packing and task-graph NodeIds are not ID code, and a
# constant under #if 0 is not read.
# A converted or scaled Go literal (uint64(1) << 22, 4 * (1 << 22)) and a brace-initialized C++ literal
# (std::uint64_t{1} << 22) are sizes.
